harness_source:
import ast,base64,hashlib,json,re,sys,time,signal
signal.alarm(30)
START=time.monotonic()
source=open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read()
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()=="32a2952e3b4c3ff2ab73a747238862d3446c31bf4896c869bc9efacb1ba8fe49"
tree=ast.parse(source)
names={"refusal_snapshot_counts","refusal_admission_snapshots"}
selected=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in names]
assert len(selected)==2
ns={"base64":base64,"hashlib":hashlib,"json":json,"re":re}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=selected,type_ignores=[]),"exact-two-reviewed-functions","exec"),ns)
gen=ns["refusal_admission_snapshots"]
rid=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(b"127.0.0.1\0general").digest()).rstrip(b"=")
iid=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(rid).digest()).rstrip(b"=")
rate=b"http_rates/"+rid
index=lambda sec:b"index_expiry_http_rates/"+str(sec+60).zfill(20).encode()+b"/"+iid
id_value=b'"'+rid+b'"'
pack=lambda rows:b"".join(k.hex().encode()+b"|"+v.hex().encode()+b"\n" for k,v in sorted(rows.items()))
def fixture(start=100,count=5):
 return {rate:json.dumps([start,count],separators=(",",":")).encode(),index(start):id_value,b"index_counts/http_rates":b"1",b"users/synthetic-user":b"opaque-protected",b"audit/synthetic-entry":b"opaque-audit",b"maintenance_cursors/synthetic":b"opaque-cursor"}
def wanted(before,start,count):
 r=before.copy();old=next(k for k,v in r.items() if k.startswith(b"index_expiry_http_rates/") and v==id_value);del r[old];r[index(start)]=id_value;r[rate]=json.dumps([start,count],separators=(",",":")).encode();return pack(r)
completed=[];failed=None

def case(name,fn):
 global failed
 try:fn();completed.append(name)
 except BaseException:failed=name;raise

def equal(actual,expected):
 assert set(actual)==set(expected)
def refuse(before=fixture(),low=150000000000,high=150100000000,elapsed=100000000,limit=600):
 try:list(gen(before if isinstance(before,bytes) else pack(before),low,high,elapsed,limit))
 except (ValueError,OverflowError):return
 raise AssertionError("prerequisite_accepted")
def values(rows=fixture(),low=150000000000,high=150100000000,elapsed=100000000,limit=600):return list(gen(pack(rows),low,high,elapsed,limit))
try:
 f=fixture()
 case("current_window_exact_complete_snapshot",lambda:equal(values(f),[wanted(f,100,6)]))
 case("expired_window_exact_complete_snapshot",lambda:equal(values(f,160000000000,160100000000),[wanted(f,160,1)]))
 case("boundary_only_two_source_defined_results",lambda:equal(values(f,159900000000,160100000000,200000000),[wanted(f,100,6),wanted(f,160,1)]))
 case("bounded_reset_seconds",lambda:equal(values(f,161000000000,164000000000,3000000000),[wanted(f,i,1) for i in range(161,165)]))
 case("limited_current_window_cannot_be_403",lambda:equal(values(fixture(count=600)),[]))
 case("expired_limited_window_can_reset",lambda:equal(values(fixture(count=600),160000000000,160100000000),[wanted(fixture(count=600),160,1)]))
 expected=values(f)[0]
 def exact_protected():
  for key in [b"users/synthetic-user",b"audit/synthetic-entry",b"maintenance_cursors/synthetic",b"index_counts/http_rates"]:
   changed=f.copy();changed[key]=changed[key]+b"changed";changed[rate]=b"[100,6]";assert pack(changed)!=expected
  added=f.copy();added[b"users/additional"]=b"new";added[rate]=b"[100,6]";assert pack(added)!=expected
  removed=f.copy();del removed[b"users/synthetic-user"];removed[rate]=b"[100,6]";assert pack(removed)!=expected
 case("every_protected_added_removed_or_changed_row_rejected",exact_protected)
 def incorrect_tuple():
  for v in [b"[100,5]",b"[100,7]",b"[101,6]",b"[150,1]"]:
   x=f.copy();x[rate]=v;assert pack(x)!=expected
 case("missing_double_or_wrong_window_increment_rejected",incorrect_tuple)
 case("future_window_refused",lambda:refuse(fixture(start=151)))
 case("zero_count_refused",lambda:refuse(fixture(count=0)))
 case("oversized_u32_count_refused",lambda:refuse(fixture(count=2**32)))
 case("wrong_collection_count_refused",lambda:refuse({**f,b"index_counts/http_rates":b"2"}))
 case("missing_rate_refused",lambda:refuse({k:v for k,v in f.items() if k!=rate}))
 case("missing_expiry_refused",lambda:refuse({k:v for k,v in f.items() if k!=index(100)}))
 case("duplicate_expiry_refused",lambda:refuse({**f,index(101):id_value}))
 case("new_expiry_collision_refused",lambda:refuse({**f,index(160):b'"other-id"'},160000000000,160100000000))
 case("noncanonical_tuple_refused",lambda:refuse({**f,rate:b"[100, 5]"}))
 case("noncanonical_order_refused",lambda:refuse(b"".join(reversed(pack(f).splitlines(keepends=True)))))
 case("duplicate_key_refused",lambda:refuse(pack(f)+pack({rate:f[rate]})))
 case("missing_newline_refused",lambda:refuse(pack(f)[:-1]))
 case("invalid_hex_refused",lambda:refuse(b"zz|00\n"))
 case("byte_capture_limit_refused",lambda:refuse(b"x"*(8*1024**2+1)))
 case("boolean_clock_refused",lambda:refuse(low=True))
 case("reversed_clock_refused",lambda:refuse(low=151000000000,high=150000000000))
 case("excess_monotonic_duration_refused",lambda:refuse(elapsed=5000000001))
 case("clock_drift_refused",lambda:refuse(elapsed=400000000))
 case("invalid_effective_limit_refused",lambda:refuse(limit=0))
 case("oversized_effective_limit_refused",lambda:refuse(limit=100001))
except BaseException:
 result={"schema":"riauth.a09-admission-memory-root/v1","passed":False,"completed":completed,"first_failed_case":failed,"elapsed_seconds":time.monotonic()-START,"source_sha256":hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),"real_runtime":False}
 print(json.dumps(result,separators=(",",":")));sys.exit(1)
print(json.dumps({"schema":"riauth.a09-admission-memory-root/v1","passed":True,"completed":completed,"first_failed_case":None,"elapsed_seconds":time.monotonic()-START,"source_sha256":hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),"real_runtime":False},separators=(",",":")))
